FieldNotes.Comments: X-array, 0 degrees rotation. Site located in lightly vegetated sandy field with small hills in each direction. Circular irrgation systems about 1km east from center. Metal post fence about 200m east from center. Game feeder about 100m south from center. Structure with solar panel about 250m north from center. Cattle and deer present. Site completely trenched, russian bagged, and wood boards used.
